future_video.contract: Use the exact displayed still as the first frame and poster of a real clip. Preserve crop and color. Do not imitate video with CSS zoom. If implemented later, play muted inline on fine-pointer hover only; stop and reset on exit, pause offscreen, retain stills for touch and reduced motion, and do not preload video on initial page load.

treatment.method: Offline edge-preserving smoothing, mean-shift texture reduction, soft tonal posterization, warm/cool false-color palette mapping.
treatment.palette: Cobalt and violet shadows; vivid magenta, coral, orange and yellow highlights.
